newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gold Peak buys extra KH Industries stake.
newsitem.headline: Gold Peak buys extra KH Industries stake.

text.p: Gold Peak Industries (Holdings) Ltd said on Monday it had acquired an additional 45 percent stake in KH Industries (UK) Ltd for an undisclosed sum.

The company said in a statement the acquisition increased Gold Peak's stake in KH Industries to 95 percent, while the remaining five percent stake was held by an existing shareholder of KH Industries, a Britain-based venture capital fund.

KH Industries engages in the development and manufacturer of "KEF" and "Celestion" loudspeakers which are supplied to international markets through a network of over 100 distributors worldwide, it said.
